Name: Lumisteria Furniture
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
A conversion of several of my furniture mods, including : beech set, spring set, flower set, and flower pride banner set.

Configurable (you can disable each pack).

They can be found in shops or furniture catalogue.
Most furniture set can be sold at Robin's on various days. (Usually 3-2 item of the set)
Some furniture can be sold by special merchants.
You can find some of the furniture on some of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] shops.

Addition : there's a new petunia banner based on genderfluid colors.

Thanks to Violetlizabet for the conversion.
